name: Cloudflare Developer Documentation Fundamentals Glossary
description: Cloudflare Developer Documentation Fundamentals Glossary — ~412 terms used across Cloudflare's developer documentation, each tagged with the originating product (Spectrum, Workers, R2, Pages, WAF, Zero Trust, Magic Transit, DNS, etc.). The product tagging makes this glossary uniquely useful as a service-coverage map across Cloudflare's portfolio.
relationToCloudSecurity: Direct — Cloudflare is a CDN/security platform; terms cover edge security, DDoS, bot management, WAF, zero trust, DNS security, mTLS, etc.
relationToAISecurity: Includes AI-relevant entries (AI Gateway, prompt injection, LLM-related terms in WAF subset).

license.notes: Cloudflare states that all documentation on its developer documentation website is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/policies-compliances/licenses/, checked 2026-11-14). The LICENSE file of the cloudflare-docs GitHub repository says CC BY 4.0 instead. This record follows the website's statement, which covers the pages this glossary was taken from and is also the stricter of the two: attribute Cloudflare, and share derived data (the term files here) under CC BY-SA 4.0. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

tier_evidence.note: Glossary page reads with no login; the extracted term "App Launcher" appears in it.

lifecycle.notes: Rolling developer-documentation glossary, updated alongside Cloudflare product releases.

current_extraction.notes: Fetched the markdown alternate at .../glossary/index.md (returned by Cloudflare docs as text/markdown). Parsed the single 3-column table (Term | Definition | Product). Product column captured into notes as 'product: <name>'.
